title: Mythrill VTT — Spell Wizard vs. Installed Engine Capability Map

families.subCapability: Single-target (self, ally, enemy, any; 0-300 ft; relationship-enforced picker)
families.exactUnsupportedBoundary: maxTargets > 1 in single/multi mode, non-manual selectionMethod, self-targeting for damage/riders/cooldowns/missing-health (self is immediate healing at range 0 only); creature sources cannot use formula/save/periodic/cooldown/trigger routes.

families.subCapability: Bounded Ranged Circle AoE (authored-area:v1, 1-300 ft ranged, 5-60 ft step 5 radius, static, 1-8 creature targets, shared owner roll)
combinesWith: AP + mana cost (or pinned catalogue class payment)
families.exactUnsupportedBoundary: cone, line, square, cube, sphere, cylinder, wall, trail, targetingType: multi, movable/follows_caster, PC area targets, area effect/rider bundles, component-watch triggers on area, creature-source area, and independent per-target rolls.

families.subCapability: Immediate direct damage (plain NdM+/-K, M4A integer-scaled attributes, M4C caster_missing_health, M4D deterministic zero-dice)
combinesWith: authored-effect:v1 riders (plain; M4A scaled only with movement/stunned)
component-watch damage trigger (all 4 immediate damage versions)
families.exactUnsupportedBoundary: Critical hits (canCrit/criticalConfig), chanceOnHitConfig, secondaryElementType, dotConfig/hasDotEffect, shorthand attribute abbreviations (INT/STR/WIS/DEX), target-stat formulas, missing-health/deterministic inside authored-effect:v1 bundles, and creature-source scaled/deterministic/missing-health formulas.

families.subCapability: Immediate direct healing (distinct creature/ally target; explicit owner-PC self-healing at range 0; periodic healing ticks)
combinesWith: explicit self at range 0 (plain/M4A/M4D without readsHealth or cooldown)
whole-spell follow-up after damage or healing
families.exactUnsupportedBoundary: hasHotEffect/hotFormula, hasShieldEffect/shieldFormula/shields, specialEffects, self-healing with cooldowns or caster_missing_health, watching a healing part for component-watch triggers, and mixed damage+healing bundles.
families.nextStepOwner: Owner-PC self-healing / M5 / Healing follow-up lanes

families.subCapability: authored-effect:v1 single canonical rider (stunned, movementFeet -60..+60, signed attribute modifier, positive flat DR +1..+20)
combinesWith: optional direct damage or healing (M4A scaled only with movement/stunned)
negates save (movement/stunned with direct part only)
families.exactUnsupportedBoundary: Generic Wizard buffConfig, debuffConfig, utilityConfig, purificationConfig, restorationConfig, transformationConfig, statusEffectsConfig, combinedEffects, negative flat DR, multi-attribute changes, stacking two attribute/DR/periodic effects on one target, and Stunned/flat-DR combined App witness (server + mounted UI only).

families.subCapability: GM-recorded rider-local 'negates' save on movement or stunned (with direct damage/healing part)
combinesWith: movement or stunned rider + direct damage/healing (plain or M4A scaled)
families.exactUnsupportedBoundary: Automated VTT save rolling, saves on direct damage/healing part (savingThrow/savingThrowConfig), partial/halves outcomes (awaiting creator decision), rider-only saves without direct part, saves on periodic or flat-DR effects, and creature-source saves.

families.subCapability: Structured target-turn expiry (next-start/end, counted 2-10) & M5 periodic damage/healing ticks (each-tick roll)
combinesWith: periodic ticks + same-kind immediate part (M4A scaled allowed)
families.evidenceProvenance: MYTHRILL_CROSS_TRACK_COORDINATION.md (Ongoing-effects display in CombatTimeline App witness 2026-11-15); server/tests/p14m2aDurations.production.test.js; p14m5Periodic.production.test.js; p14m5Composition.production.test.js
families.exactUnsupportedBoundary: Wizard Step durationConfig (rounds/minutes/hours/concentration/permanent), persistentConfig, roll-once-at-cast periodic, periodic ticks on PC targets, saves on periodic ticks, component-watch next to periodic ticks, and creature-source immediate+periodic.

families.subCapability: authenticated_caster_start (1-10 strictly upcoming caster-turn starts on primary owner PC)
combinesWith: movement, stunned, attribute, or flat-DR rider (save only on movement/stunned)
families.exactUnsupportedBoundary: Legacy Wizard cooldowns (turn_based, short_rest, long_rest, charge_based, dice_based, conditional, real_time, encounter), area-spell cooldowns, self-healing cooldowns, and creature-source cooldowns.

families.subCapability: Whole-spell follow-up (follow_up_after_damage, follow_up_after_healing) & single-part Damage component watch (authored-component-watch-trigger:v1)

whole-spell healing follow-up: single-target or M6A area (installed, real-handler verified; App witness prepared/gated)
component watch: single-target immediate damage (all 4 versions) or direct damage + movement/stunned/attribute/flat-DR

families.exactUnsupportedBoundary: All other triggerData categories/IDs, multiple global triggers, effectTriggers on non-direct-damage parts or with periodic ticks or on area spells, conditionalEffects, buffDebuffTriggers, requiredConditions, non-CONDITIONAL triggerRole, chaining follow-ups, and creature sources. spell-driven summoning: combines with NOTHING (refused whole)
